title: Ask the path inside holy company
summary: The searching heart admits it needs a blessed friend to point it toward the Beloved Lord.
takeaway: Let holy friendship point longing home.
lifeApplication: When searching turns restless, ask someone rooted in the Guru's way to name the next faithful step instead of searching mind and body in circles.

source.shortMeaning: The seeker longs for a friendly saint who can show the way to the Beloved after every inner search runs thin.
source.lifeApplication: Bring your longing to holy friendship and let a real next step replace another private loop.

evidence.coreClaim: The seeker longs for a friendly saint who can show the way to the Beloved after every inner search runs thin.
evidence.turn: Let longing become teachable enough to be led by holy friendship.
evidence.practicalImplication: When searching turns restless, ask someone rooted in the Guru's way to name the next faithful step instead of searching mind and body in circles.
